description: Resize a PDF so every page fits A4: orientation is detected automatically and pages are scaled proportionally, all in your browser.

faqs.a: Each page is scaled proportionally to fit inside A4 (portrait or landscape chosen per page), so nothing is stretched or squashed.
Pages wider than tall become A4 landscape; taller pages become A4 portrait — decided per page, automatically.
Everything is processed locally in your browser with PDF-Lib. Your files are never uploaded to any server.

howto: Upload a PDF of any page size.
Optionally add padding around each page.
Every page is scaled to fit A4 with correct orientation.
title: Resize PDF to A4
